# Release process

The platform ships a release every second Tuesday. A release branch is cut the Thursday before, and only fixes that are linked to a tracked defect may be merged into it after the cut. The release manager rotates weekly between the four senior engineers and signs off the checklist before the production deploy.

Hotfixes skip the branch cut but still need two approvals, one of them from the owning team. Every hotfix is written up in the incident log within one working day.
